description: This file defines a singleton object `CalculationHistory` that manages an in-memory, application-wide persistent store for calculator expressions and results, supporting features like favoriting entries, filtering favorites, adding, removing, and clearing history entries.

classes.name: CalculationHistory.HistoryEntry
classes.description: Data class representing a history entry with expression, result, timestamp, and favorite status.

methods.name: toggleFavorite
methods.description: Toggles the favorite status of a history entry at a given position.

methods.name: setShowOnlyFavorites
methods.description: Sets the filter to show only favorite entries or all entries.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new expression-result pair to the history, maintaining a maximum number of entries.

methods.name: getHistory
methods.description: Returns the current list of history entries, optionally filtered to show only favorites.

methods.name: removeAt
methods.description: Removes a history entry at a specified position.
